name: NUSC 3150
title: Medical Nutrition Therapy I
description: (Also offered as DIET 3150.) Introduction to the nutrition care process, nutrition assessment, planning of special diets and applications of medical nutrition therapy to selected disease states and conditions.
requirement_description: MCB 2000; PNB 2264, 2265; NUSC 1165; open only to Dietetics majors and NUSC Didactic Program students: open to juniors or higher.
